zh-Hans.name: DeepReader: Read with AI
zh-Hans.subtitle: 结合上下文理解文档与电子书
zh-Hans.promotional_text: 内置千问，免费离线解释选文和追问，无广告、API Key 或购买次数。支持可调侧栏与悬浮助手。AI 答案可能不准确，请核对原文。
zh-Hans.keywords: 阅读,电子书,离线,千问,文献,笔记,高亮,书单,PDF,EPUB
zh-Hans.description:
DeepReader 是原生 Mac 文档与电子书阅读器，把免费离线 AI 助手放在正文旁边。

内置千问，全部免费
Qwen3 0.6B 量化小模型随应用安装，解释和追问完全在 Mac 本机运行。无需账户、API Key、服务器或额外模型下载；无广告、订阅、内购或问答次数限制。阅读内容不会为 AI 推理上传。

边读边理解
打开文件，选中文字后按 ⌘⇧D，获得结合附近语境的简短解释。继续追问，成功回答自动保存在本机历史。拖动侧栏边缘调整正文与答案空间，或切换为悬浮窗口，保持阅读位置。

选择回答依据
可选择仅依据书中文字，或结合模型已有的通用知识；两者都不联网搜索。仅书中内容也不能保证答案完全准确。

自己的阅读书库
支持 PDF、EPUB、TXT、Markdown 和未加 DRM 的 MOBI/AZW3。搜索正文、保存高亮、评分、标记读完、整理书单，并按星级归档原格式副本。PDF 可保存批注或副本；电子书高亮保存在本机。

答案可能不准确
AI 可能给出错误、不完整或虚构的信息，仅供辅助阅读。请核对原文，不要仅凭 AI 回答作出重要决定。小模型适合简单词句释义，复杂推理、计算和专业知识可能不可靠。

使用限制
• 短段落问答最多取选文前 500 字、附近语境前 600 字；追问前 300 字及历史末尾 250 字。输入和回答有长度上限；这不是付费次数限制。
• 本版不提供全文或日、周、月总结。
• 需要 macOS 13.3 或更高版本，支持 Apple 芯片和 Intel Mac。约需 500 MB 存储空间，首次运行需初始化，生成会增加耗电和发热，速度取决于设备。
• 不支持 DRM、Kindle KFX、扫描文件 OCR 或跨设备同步。电子书搜索作用于当前章节。
• 提供中文和英文界面。

DeepReader 是独立阅读器，不是模型开发者的官方产品。

en-US.name: DeepReader: Read with AI
en-US.subtitle: Read with context
en-US.promotional_text: Free offline Qwen explanations and follow-ups, with a resizable or floating assistant. No ads, API keys or purchases. AI answers may be inaccurate; check the source.
en-US.description:
DeepReader is a native Mac document and ebook reader with a free offline AI assistant beside your text.

Bundled Qwen, entirely free
A quantized Qwen3 0.6B model is installed with the app. Explanations and follow-ups run on your Mac, without an account, API key, server or separate model download. No ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases or question quota. Reading content is not uploaded for AI inference.

Understand as you read
Open a file, select text and press Command-Shift-D for a short contextual explanation. Ask follow-ups and revisit successful answers in local History. Resize the sidebar or switch to a floating window while preserving your reading position.

Choose the answer scope
Use only the supplied book text, or allow the model's learned general knowledge. Neither mode searches the web. Book-only mode does not guarantee accurate answers.

Your own library
Read PDF, EPUB, TXT, Markdown and DRM-free MOBI/AZW3. Search, highlight, rate books, mark them finished and archive original-format copies into rating folders. Save PDF annotations or copies; ebook highlights remain local.

Answers may be inaccurate
AI may produce incorrect, incomplete or fabricated information. Use it as a reading aid, check the source, and do not rely solely on AI for important decisions. The small model suits simple explanations; complex reasoning, calculations and specialist knowledge may be unreliable.

Limitations
• Short-passage Q&A uses up to the first 500 characters of a selection, 600 of nearby context, 300 of a question and the last 250 of history. Input/output length limits protect responsiveness; they are not paid quotas.
• Full-document and daily, weekly or monthly summaries are not included.
• Requires macOS 13.3 or later on Apple silicon or Intel. Allow about 500 MB of storage. Initial model setup takes time; generation increases power use and warmth. Speed depends on the device.
• DRM, Kindle KFX, scanned-document OCR and cross-device sync are unsupported. Ebook search covers the current chapter.
• Chinese and English interfaces are included.

DeepReader is an independent reader, not an official product of the model developer.
